items.text: New quality of life improvements, fan requests, and bug fixes are LIVE to enhance your Five Nights at Freddy's: Into the Pit experience.
Ukrainian
Indonesian
Traditional Chinese
Fixed getting stuck in the Under Oswald's Bed minigame
Resolved Chica getting stuck by doors
Fixed buttons appearing as white boxes
Prevented Freddy from being visible during minigames
Fixed the window escape QTE in Oswald's room
Addressed getting stuck in the vent after calling Mom on Night 5
Removed duplicate recording dots from the CCTV UI
Fixed getting stuck when using the wrong item for the Party Room door
Prevented getting stuck if Oswald is caught while using a door
Enabled the Speedrun Timer from the Main Menu
Corrected Steam achievement display issues
Allowed interaction with Jinx after reloading a saved file
More languages on the way
Minigame tutorial improvements
Additional bug fixes!

Console players! We are approved with all patches in all regions for console release and also have a final date approved by the Scottgames team to go live. As soon as we have approval to share the date, we will make an announcement! We are doing everything we can to give all console players the best version of the game possible on console launch day, including all fan requests, bug fixes, and quality-of-life updates. All consoles will also launch in all regions on the same day.

Your feedback is invaluable to us. We always strive to make Five Nights at Freddy's: Into the Pit the best experience possible. If you have any questions or suggestions or encounter any other issues, please don't hesitate to reach out to our community forums, report via our Bug Report Google Form or join our Discord server.
Thank you for your continued support! 🐻

Pepperoni pals! We've got one last hotfix rolling out for you before the weekend hits! Thank you all so much for your patience and love during this launch, and we'll be continuing to roll out more improvements and fixes next week.

This update is now live on our public beta branch. You can opt in by following the instructions in the video attached below. The fix will also be rolled out to the default branch once it’s confirmed to be stable.
Fixed being unable to open pause menu to call mom
Fixed rare endless scroll on main menu
Fixed some items missing in the Extras menu
Fixed black screen when opening the inventory after jumping Into the Pit: Hotfix v1.0.1.0 fixed this issue when opening the map
Fixed Extras Menu Inventory not showing highlights properly
Fixed Chica's Scream SFX missing after pausing the game for several seconds
Fixed Sketchbook inventory description being incorrect
Pause Menu now auto-scrolls when holding up/down buttons
Going back from New Game to Main Menu now highlights the expected button
Fixed some text not being affected by Dyslexic accessibility
Fixed phone button staying highlighted after calling Mom
Fixed some text overflowing in some languages and font settings
Fixed dyslexic font reverting to default when returning to the title screen
(Note: most of these are only happening to some users)
Softlock when talking to Mike and Chip
Performance issues when using controllers
Inputs not working on main menu
Softlock when holding breath as the yellow rabbit appears
Achievement notification sometimes remains for 15+ minutes
White boxes instead of key prompts in some cases
Game doesn’t resume after minimizing, with looping sound effects
Missing phone keypad highlights
Quest incorrectly asks to find Chip and Mike after they've already been found
Battery UI not reappearing after playing arcade minigames
Rare cases of crashes
If you need further assistance, please reach us on Steam Discussions, Steam Live Chat, and/or Discord!
See you in the pit! ːsteamhappyː

items.text: Hey there, pizza lovers! Thank you so much for keeping us informed about the bugs you encounter. We've been actively listening to your feedback and reports, and have prepared a hotfix at lightning speed to address some of the more urgent issues! We'll be continuing to work on more updates regarding known issues, so if your issue is not listed here feel free to bring it to our attention in the comments!

This update is now live on our public beta branch. You can opt in by following the instructions in the video attached below. The fix will also be rolled out to the default branch once it’s confirmed to be stable.
Fixed Night 5 blocker where girl wouldn't spawn in the party room
Fixed Oswald sometimes getting stuck on the kitchen door
Fixed Oswald movement stopping when Freddy and Bonnie both use the door
Fixed black screen when opening the map after jumping Into the Pit: We have found that the inventory key still causes this issue
Fixed hints not closing when they appear while Oswald is near a door
Fixed input not working when retrying a Door QTE after being previously caught
Fixed Issue Reporting Tool not being clickable in some minigames
Reduced dialogue box opacity
Improved several translations
Updated Objective SFX
Fixed the Store Page's French localization!
